import cadquery as cq
import math

# === 参数 ===
outer_d = 20     # 外径 (mm)
inner_d = 15     # 内径 (mm)
thickness = 1.2  # 厚度 (mm)
gap_angle = 30   # 开口角度 (度)

# === 建模 ===
# 环形
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(outer_d / 2)
    .circle(inner_d / 2)
    .extrude(thickness)
)

# 开口切割
gap_w = outer_d * math.sin(math.radians(gap_angle / 2))
gap_l = outer_d
cut_box = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(gap_l, gap_w, thickness * 3)
    .translate((gap_l / 2, 0, 0))
)
result = result.cut(cut_box)

show_object(result)
